events.verdict: Braun (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in Murray's (NOP) path and absorbs the contact as the two players come together.

Gordon (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in Jones' (NOP) path and the two players engage. Gordon moves backwards as a result of the contact, but he does not further extend into Jones' path.
Gordon (DEN) loses his balance on his own accord and not as a result of any illegal contact by Jones (NOP) during the contest.
Both Braun (DEN) and Jokic (DEN) legally contest Murray's (NOP) jump shot attempt and allow him space to land.
Jokic (DEN) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps before making the pass.
Missi (NOP) steps forward to contest Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt in the post and the body contact is marginal.
Jones (NOP) places his forearm against Westbrook (DEN) while he is airborne reaching for the rebound, but the contact is marginal.
Jones (NOP) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Play is stopped to confirm if there is a clock malfunction.
Missi (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position during Jokic's (DEN) drive to the basket before the shot is cleanly blocked by McCollum (NOP).
Murray (NOP) is considered in the frontcourt when he receives the pass.
Westbrook (DEN) and Watson (DEN) legally contest McCollum's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Westbrook (DEN) reaches in and makes contact with the ball, causing Murray (NOP) to briefly lose control. Any contact with Murray before the contact to the ball is marginal.
Murray (NOP) grabs Jokic's (DEN) arm, affecting his ability to control the rebound.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests Jones' (NOP) driving shot attempt.
Jones (NOP) briefly grasps Gordon's (DEN) jersey and does not affect his ability to get to the rebound.
Missi (NOP) rests an arm on Jokic's (DEN) body before cleanly blocking the shot attempt.

Replay review of the goaltend called on Missi (NOP) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Missi blocks the shot attempt by Jokic (DEN) while it is still on its upward trajectory towards the basket. New Orleans would imminently possess the ball and are therefore awarded possession when play resumes.
Jones (NOP) is in a legal guarding position during Westbrook's (DEN) driving shot attempt and the body contact is incidental.
Gordon (DEN) jumps early for the rebound and is not grabbed or otherwise impeded by an opponent.
Murray (NOP) places a hand on Jokic's (DEN) body as he makes the pass and the contact is marginal.
Missi (NOP) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Jones (NOP) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on McCollum (NOP).
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Missi (NOP).
Westbrook (DEN) disconcerts the free throw shooter.
Missi (NOP) crosses the plane of the free throw line before his attempt can make contact with the rim.
